chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad ibn Abān, from Zakkār ibn Farqad, from ʿUthmān ibn Ziyād, who said:
I said to Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام: I am on a journey and come upon standing water, while my hand is dirty, so I dip it into the water? He said: “There is no harm.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to dip a dirty hand into standing water while traveling?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning water and ritual purity during travel. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that there is no problem in dipping a dirty hand into standing water in the circumstance described.
